evidence: The HfO2 films were deposited at 250°C using O2 plasma via either Hf/H20849NEt2/H208504 or Hf/H20849mp/H208504 as the Hf precursor. Both precursors were delivered from an external reservoir at 90°C and pulsed into the reactor using an Ar carrier gas with a flow rate of 30 sccm. The remote O2 plasma was supplied as the oxygen source and the Ar gas as the purge and carrier gas.
